description: This source file defines the GatewayLaunchAgentManager enum, which provides functionalities to manage launch agents for a gateway application on macOS. It includes methods for enabling, disabling, checking the status of launch agents, and managing configuration snapshots. The code interacts with the file system, runs shell commands, and handles JSON parsing related to launchd configurations.

methods.name: isLaunchAgentWriteDisabled
methods.description: Checks if the launch agent write is disabled by verifying the presence of a marker file.

methods.name: setLaunchAgentWriteDisabled
methods.description: Creates or removes the disable marker file to enable or disable launch agent writes.

methods.name: isLoaded
methods.description: Asynchronously checks if the launch agent daemon is loaded.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Enables or disables the launch agent based on provided parameters, utilizing logging and command execution.

methods.name: launchdConfigSnapshot
methods.description: Creates a snapshot of the current launch agent configuration.

methods.name: launchdGatewayLogPath
methods.description: Determines the path to the gateway's launchd logs, prioritizing stdout and stderr paths from snapshot.
